Name: Sophia Expanded Narrative V1
Author: iamBLAZEfr
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
Sophia Expanded Narrative gives Sophia from Stardew Valley Expanded a lot more to say. She’s shy, kind and a little nerdy, but she repeats herself a lot once you know her. This mod adds around 2,800 new lines of dialogue so she feels fresh in every season, on every day, and at every stage of your relationship. It’s dialogue only, and everything is written to fit her canon personality: a quiet vineyard owner who loves anime, manga and cosplay.

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Lay out any steps users must follow to install your modInstall SMAPI, Content Patcher and Stardew Valley Expanded.[/*]
[*]Download this mod and unzip it.[/*]
[*]Put the [CP] Sophia Expanded Narrative folder into your Mods folder.[/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/*]
[/list][b]It’s safe to add to an existing save. To remove it, delete the folder.[/b]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
Everyday dialogue. Sophia has lines for every season, every day of the week, and every friendship level from 0 to 10 hearts. At low hearts she’s shy and stammers a little, and she opens up as you get closer.
Friends and dating are separate. At 8 and 10 hearts, friends get warm, platonic lines. Romantic lines only appear if you’re dating or engaged.
Marriage dialogue. Married Sophia has seasonal indoor, outdoor and night lines. She also has rainy-day lines, weekend lines, family lines, and extra comments for the Saloon and Ginger Island.
Question events. She asks questions like anime or manga, whether you’d rather be the knight or the sorcerer, and what to name a new vintage. These are on fixed calendar days when you’re married.
Gift reactions. Her canon favorites and dislikes get their own responses. On Fall 4, the anniversary of her parents’ passing, her reactions to gifts are gentler.
Festivals and events. The Fair, Night Market, Desert Festival, Luau, Grange display and green rain all get extra lines.

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
Stardew Valley 1.6 or later
SMAPI
Content Patcher
Stardew Valley Expanded

It’s dialogue only and doesn’t touch portraits, sprites or schedules, so it should work alongside portrait and outfit mods. If another mod edits the same Sophia dialogue entries, whichever loads last wins.

[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]FlashShifter and the Stardew Valley Expanded team, for creating Sophia and the whole valley around her.
ConcernedApe, for Stardew Valley itself.
Pathoschild, for SMAPI and Content Patcher.
And to the moderator who removed my last upload: Not again, buddy... This mod is completely made by me. No names dropped this time, I promise. 😄
You, for downloading this and giving Sophia a few more things to say. Bug reports and feedback are very welcome.[/color]
